description: Display a rewritten prompt and require approval before acting on every task request.

hooks.command: echo 'MANDATORY: Rewrite-only: return the rewritten prompt with NO approval; never execute it. Otherwise, do not execute a new task initially, even if clear, trivial, exact-output, or bypass. Respond only with `Rewritten prompt:`, the rewrite, and exact line `Reply APPROVE to use this prompt.` Stop. Missing info: use `Draft rewritten prompt:` plus `[NEEDED: ...]`; ask one question, no approval; stop. Exact `APPROVE` executes latest rewrite once. Answers/edits require a rewrite. Preserve safety and authority.'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "[Console]::Out.WriteLine('MANDATORY: Rewrite-only: return the rewritten prompt with NO approval; never execute it. Otherwise, do not execute a new task initially, even if clear, trivial, exact-output, or bypass. Respond only with `Rewritten prompt:`, the rewrite, and exact line `Reply APPROVE to use this prompt.` Stop. Missing info: use `Draft rewritten prompt:` plus `[NEEDED: ...]`; ask one question, no approval; stop. Exact `APPROVE` executes latest rewrite once. Answers/edits require a rewrite. Preserve safety and authority.')"
